title: Clean up owned Chrome profiles after the session-list browser guard finishes
outcome: The session-list guard releases its owned browser profile directories while preserving useful diagnostic artifacts.
acceptance: After the guard's normal and reduced-mode browser children finish, it attempts bounded cleanup of only its resolved repository-local mkdtemp profile paths, including failure paths.
Logs and results remain available for diagnosis; cleanup failures identify retained owned profiles and never delete another run's files.
